params.body:
## What went wrong

A dealer (French UI) entering a Jeep Avenger could not leave the Algemeen step: "Encore 1 champ obligatoire à remplir : Modèle", while the Model field showed "Avenger".

The model list on the Livewire sheet (`VehicleForm::render`) had no empty first option, unlike the make list, and `x-ui.select` only renders one when it gets a placeholder. After a make is chosen `model_id` is `''`. When no option matches the bound value, the browser selects the first option: Avenger is alphabetically first under Jeep. So the dealer saw a filled-in field and the server saw an empty one. The classic sheet had the same gap, in the list rendered on open and in the script that refills the list after a make change. This was already the case before #850.

## The fix

- **Model list, Livewire and classic:** the list now starts with an empty option. It uses the same mechanism as the make list (`pluck(..., with_empty_pair)`) in `VehicleForm::render` and `OwnStockController::create`/`edit`. After a make change, `resources/js/vehicle/create.js` and `ownstock/create.blade.php` add an empty option first and select it (`val('')` instead of `val(0)`). `withCurrentModel()` still adds the vehicle's own model, and its sort keeps the empty option first.
- **Chassis lookup (`OwnStockService::mapModel`, now public and typed `?int`):**
  - it takes the row with exactly the looked-up name, where case and spaces do not count (R S1-3.22), and prefers the row still in use;
  - a merged row is returned as it is, so `Vehicle::booted` follows it to the survivor on save and folds its trim;
  - without an exact name it takes the shortest active name that starts with the looked-up one, then tries again with the last word dropped;
  - with no match it returns `null`, so the model stays empty.
- **Draft on model 0:** a draft row keeps the column default `model_id = 0` until a model is chosen. `VehicleForm::mount` now reads that as `''` on a draft (`is_complete = 0`), so "Next" asks for the model. A saved vehicle keeps what it has, so an edit of an old vehicle on model 0 is not blocked now.

## Lookup path findings

- The lookup (`createFromVIN`) writes to the draft row, and the browser then reloads the sheet (`vehicle_form_preview`: `location.href = ...&tab=general`). `mount` assigns the properties directly, so `updatedManufacturerId()` does **not** run and cannot wipe a looked-up model. `followMergedModel()` runs in mount after that reload, and `Vehicle::booted` follows merges on every Eloquent save, `tempupdate` included.
- The old `mapModel` took the lowest id whose name started with the looked-up name, whether the row was active, switched off or merged. So "3008" could land on the folded "3008 GT", and the save then put GT in the trim of a plain 3008. After dropping each word it ended on `LIKE '%'`, so a name that no row knew got the make's oldest model. It returned 0 only for a make with no models at all.
- A model 0 passed `required|numeric`, so a draft on model 0 went through the step without a model.
- AutoConnect's block B re-maps make and model whenever the draft's package is empty, which is often the case after VWE. With `null` for no match it could now empty a model that VWE found. So it writes the model only when it found one, or when it switches to another make.
- I could not reconstruct the exact production path for the reported vehicle from here. Model 3922 "Avenger" is the only Avenger row, active and not merged, so the old `mapModel` would have found it for "Avenger". The report matches the manual path: the make was chosen by hand, or re-chosen after the lookup. That path is the model list fix.

## Other required selects on the sheet (audited, unchanged)

- These lists have an empty first option: `construction_year`, `category_id`, `usage_category_id`, `transmission_type_id`, `fuel_type_id`, `color_id`, `paint_type_id` (all `pluck(..., true, true)`), `manufacturer_id`, `euronorm` (`Enumeration::euronorms()`), `VATNeeded`, `cleanliness_interior`, `cleanliness_exterior` and `engine_status`.
- `body_style_id` has an empty option, but its key is `0` (`BodyStyleRepository::pluck` prepends `"" => 0`). The field shows blank while nothing is chosen, so it misleads nobody. A caveat: `'0'` passes `required|numeric` there too. That is left alone here.
- `available_within_months` and `radius` (Data step) always hold a valid value: the defaults are `'0'` and column `NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`, which match "now" and "no limit". `bidding_type` is normalised to a valid type in mount.
- `VATPercentage` has one option (the dealer's rate) and a draft holds `0`, so the field shows that rate while the property is `0`. It is left alone. The field is greyed out until "BTW-wagen" is answered. Adding an empty option would make `required` refuse a "no VAT" vehicle, which the view comment explicitly avoids. The stored value is not read anywhere; only the Hexon import writes it.
- The offer, order and rental forms have no model select. The model filters in the stock, bidding and average-price browsers already start with an empty option.

## Rules

- R S1-3.2: while no model is chosen, the Model field is empty.
- R S1-2.8: how the lookup picks a model.
- The finding `bevinding: een-model-leek-gekozen` is added and resolved here.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/VehicleFormModelChosenTest.php` (`@rule S1-3.2`, `S1-9.13`, `S1-2.8`, `S1-3.22`):
- the list starts empty and the empty option is selected after a make is chosen;
- "Next" names the model until one is chosen, and the chosen model is then the selected option;
- a draft on model 0 opens without a model and is refused;
- a lookup name matches regardless of case and spaces, and is not captured by an older folded row;
- a lookup on a merged row is stored on the survivor with the trim, and the sheet opens on it;
- a lookup with no match leaves the model empty, the empty option selected, and "Next" refusing.

I checked that the tests fail without the fix, for the list and for the draft normalisation.

Locally: full suite green (2365 tests), Rules* and QualityRatchet green, PHPStan no errors, Pint passes on the new test. The now unused `IVehicleModelRepository` injection in `OwnStockService` is removed (PHPStan `property.onlyWritten`; only commented-out code referred to it).
params.title: A model is chosen, not assumed: empty first option and an honest chassis lookup
